# Ciné Lumière

## About this venue

With a spacious and elegant Art Deco auditorium, 229 seats, a good-sized stage, a 4K DCI Digital Cinema Projector and an experienced team, **Ciné Lumière** is the ideal space for high profile events, from private screenings and press launches to conferences, corporate meetings and concerts. Combine your event with a party, or a cocktail reception in the adjoining spaces of Les Salons, the Listed Library or Le Foyer.

**The form below is currently out of order, please contact hire@institut-francais.org.uk for any enquiry.**

Contact Us

- **Capacity:** 225 + 2 wheelchair positions
- **Accessibility:** Yes, Stairs and public lift, disabled access
- **Type of event:** Private screenings, press launches, conferences, corporate meetings and concerts

### Facilities

- Blackout
- WIFI
- Air conditioning
- Stage size: 4m x 8m
- Dimmable stage lights
- 4K DCI Digital Cinema Projection
- 35mm Projection compatible with change overs
- Screen | Perforated front projection screen with variable side, top and bottom masking, Maximum size: 8.0 x 3.5 meters
- Cinema Surround Sound up to 7.1
- Separate Live sound PA

### Available on request

- **Furniture:** chairs, tables, lectern
- Concert Piano Steinway
- Microphones for talks/conferences
- Equipment for live music
- Visio-conferencing, webinar, virtual and hybrid events
- Filming and recording services
- Post-production services including creating DCPs (SMPTE or INTEROP)

# Venue Hire

Situated in the heart of South Kensington, one of the most fashionable locations in London, the Institut français is a stone’s throw from the V&A, the Natural History Museum and the South Kensington tube station.

## The Perfect Setting for your Event

Our outstanding heritage building, with its stylish Art Deco premises, is home to eight varied spaces, one of which will assuredly suit your needs. Two cinema rooms: Ciné Lumière and Ciné Lumière II; our delightful Art Deco Listed Library; our charming, intimate yet versatile Salons; the Atelier for creative uses; and our two smaller meeting rooms the Salle Baudoin and the Studios.

The Institut français du Royaume-Uni makes an original venue for all types of events such as corporate events, board meetings, press screenings, presentations, launches, receptions, and dinners.

 

### Catering and Services

All our rooms have WIFI and a modern AV equipment is available on request. Our onsite conferencing team will work with you to plan your event as smoothly as possible and will provide technical support if needed.

Accommodation hire fees are exempt from VAT. The hire charge includes the equipment mentioned in the description; furniture hire is available upon request. Staff costs are included (except security, cloakroom, attendant, receptionist).

To make your event stand out with great taste, our Brasserie Gazette is perfect for your office breakfasts, business meetings and receptions. Brasserie Gazette will provide you with a gourmet list of catering options upon request.
